parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood for strength and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the door, drawer, and base components.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a front panel made of MDF, designed to cover and protect the storage space inside.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet’s interior when opened and conceals contents when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges attached to the frame, allowing swinging motion.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a sliding compartment made of solid wood, located above the cabinet door.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a small storage space for utensils or small items, easily accessible by pulling.
parts.Movement_description: It slides in and out along rails or grooves for smooth operation.

parts.name: Rectangle (Other)
parts.Basic_description: This rectangular component is likely an internal divider or shelf made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It supports or separates internal storage areas within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom support structure made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and supports the weight of the entire cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.
